title: National ACERT Grant Program Authorization Act
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.
summary:
National ACERT Grant Program Authorization Act

This bill requires the Department of Justice, in coordination with the Department of Health and Human Services, to award grants for states, Indian tribes, localities, and community-based organizations to establish response teams to address adverse childhood experiences associated with exposure to trauma.
